8/22/2022, 12:00pm – 2:00pm 

8/23/2022, 8:00 am – 10:00am

If you were unable to make our previously scheduled Open House dates, please feel free to stop by the office on Monday or Tuesday this week to pick up student schedules if needed, locate classrooms, and practice opening lockers.
